steps.assistant_text: Retrospective verified source port onto frozen upstream. Independent native C, original USO identities, both raw modes, full ROM, six strict code-block payloads and no exact/raw/partial regression pass. Canonical and remote branches untouched.

analysis.purpose: Emits geometry/texture state, numbers and processes linked texture-like nodes, then appends an RDP pipe-sync packet. Higher-level ownership remains uncertain.
analysis.observed_abi: MIPS o32: a0 is homed but unused; its caller supplies a module-data address. a1 points to the display-list context and a2 to the node chain. The caller ignores the function result, so its original return convention remains unproved.

calls.observed_abi: a0=context pointer, a1=node pointer, a2=32-bit packet offset. Result ignored; original return ABI unknown. Recovered relocation identity: bootup func_06BF20.
a0=node pointer; signed 32-bit result in v0, divided by eight with truncation toward zero. Recovered relocation identity: bootup func_066724.

evidence: Immutable assembly contains one 117-word function, a 0x28-byte frame, two direct calls and one return.
Both compiled function hashes equal the immutable target: 88e720174df295456aba55e0f3cf459f6d5ae23db7f857fdd696e170c3c549f2.
Inspected shared-node family: caller gl_func_00043654, assigned function, gl_func_000578B4, gl_func_000520B8 and gl_func_00052144.
Recovered GLRenderNode fields remain offset-named: halfwords 0x20/0x22/0x88; words 0x18/0x24/0x28/0x38/0x3C; pointers 0x1C/0x40/0x64/0x68.
Reused existing GL470E4 display-list types: context+0xC references a descriptor with buffer+0 and count+4; packets occupy eight bytes.
An o32 integer address carrier reproduces the final descriptor/index allocation. Storing through the shared struct field preserves the offset-4 store without an extra address instruction.
Distinct zero-valued aliases retain inline relocation provenance. Callsites are original game_libs offsets, calculated from bootup Text offsets minus 0x1466C.
Normal/NON_MATCHING builds, ROM byte comparison, all six compressed-code checks and the unchanged-other-functions check passed.

Fresh upstream port: original compiler in both modes, complete native call/data USO identity checks, exact source-generated tables/constants, exact host function bytes, full ROM and all six strict original code-block payloads.
hypotheses: The halfwords at 0x20/0x22 represent texture dimensions, with format selection at 0x24 controlling bytes per texel.
unknowns: Original leading-argument pointee type and ignored return conventions.
No unresolved direct call identities remain at the assigned sites; broader indirect-call coverage remains limited.
Original typedef spellings are not proved by instruction equality.

The surrounding host definition preserves compiler/RoData context; the required independently compiled C implementation is src/match_imports/gl_func_00045E20.c. This is not a proof of original source spelling or whole-program portable source.

limitations: Indirect calls and missing recovered relocations stay unresolved; alias value zero is not an identity.
Observed indirect calls prove possible executed targets only; preserve indirect C dispatch and other unknown runtime targets.
